parts.note_add: S-001 page 24 (section G) draws it as G-01 relay, G-02 motor and G-13 switch, fed from the 20 A LR fuse on the switched L line from the ignition switch; the 1985 manual puts the assembly behind the right rear trunk side trim (other year, confirm where it is on this car). The complete FB assembly FA01-66-930C appears to be no longer available; the 1984-85 FA42-66-930A still lists at Mazda dealers.

Sellers list the mast as FA42-66-941A for 1981-85 (the pole with its nylon drive cord); FB masts do not interchange with 1979-80 masts. The brittle nylon drive cord is the usual failure. Whether FA42-66-941A replaces FA01-66-941A needs confirming.
1985 manual: to remove the antenna, take out the right rear trunk side trim, then disconnect the feeder and the connector (other year; confirm).

S-001 G-01 has six wires: LR, R, LY and B on one side, LG and L on the other. The coil runs from LR through a diode to LG, and LG is grounded by the radio or by the G-13 antenna switch. A used FB relay was listed under the number FA01-67-740, which differs from the catalogue's FA01-66-947 (confirm).

No test value was found in any source. An rx7club thread (1985 context) says a switch that responds to voltage turns the motor off at the end of travel, which suggests the bi-metal switch is the thermal cut-out at the end of travel (confirm).

Still sold new as 8532-76-672: Mazdatrix lists it at 48.39 USD, Atkins at 99 USD. The same pump fits 1979-94 RX-7s and many other Mazdas. S-001 feeds it from the IG 10 A LB fuse, and the combination switch grounds its LY wire. To diagnose, put 12 V across the pump and see if it runs; if it does, the fault is in the circuit (the switch contact tab is the known 1st-gen failure).
Atkins Rotary sells a 1979-83 12A washer bottle as 0317-67-511A (35 USD, without the cap), a different number from the catalogue's 2522-76-671A; confirm it fits before buying.
Still sold new as 1011-67-510A for all 1979-83 RX-7s (Atkins Rotary, 21 USD, in stock); the nozzle gasket 1011-67-511B is sold separately.

specs.note: 1985 manual names the feed L and the switched wire LY (connector D-02). The 1982 feed is LB (S-001 p18). If the pump does not run with LY grounded, replace it
